mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations that increase real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market anomaly where job losses occur amid tightening conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates exceeding 4.0% during a tightening cycle signal accelerated monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
